The signs are rectangular with rounded corners, featuring white text on dark backgrounds (one appears reddish-brown, the other dark brown/black). The text is heavily distorted and illegible, resembling gibberish or melted characters rather than standard typography.

The mounting hardware lacks clear mechanical logic; the bands seem to merge with the pole texture rather than sitting distinctly on top of it.
The sign faces have a slight wavy distortion and lack the perfect planar flatness expected of manufactured metal/plastic signs.
